steps.caption: Quickselect: the 2nd largest is the value at index 4 in sorted order. Partition, then keep only the side that contains index 4.
Partition [0..5] around 4: it lands at index 3. Target 4 is to the right: drop the left side.
Partition [4..5] around 5: it lands at index 4. That's the target index. Done.
Answer 5. One side per round: n + n/2 + n/4 … ≈ 2n → O(n) on average (O(n²) worst case).
